arStrings.szText:
Casting {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} causes you to explode, dealing {c:FF44A68E}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_2]{/c} Fire damage. While {c_important}Wrath of the Berserker{/c} is active, your direct damage dealt is converted into Fire. 

You deal {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased Fire damage.
